title: אלישע בעל כנפים

paragraphs: Elisha Ba'al Kenafayim (“possessor of wings”). He was so called because they decreed against wearing tefillin. An official met him and asked, “What is in your hand?” He answered, “Dove’s wings,” and through a miracle they became so. Tomnin 49a; Rabbi Eliezer de-Milah 130a. Apparently he lived in the tannaim’s time.
